rows.answer: Construct triangle BCD with sides S_4, S_5, S_6. On line BC, construct point H_0 such that CH_0^2 - BH_0^2 = S_2^2 - S_1^2, and draw line \ell_1 perpendicular to BC at H_0. On line BD, construct point H_1 such that DH_1^2 - BH_1^2 = S_3^2 - S_1^2, and draw line \ell_2 perpendicular to BD at H_1. Let H be the intersection of \ell_1 and \ell_2. Construct a right triangle with hypotenuse S_1 and leg BH; the other leg is the desired altitude.
